description.en: A self-contained agent preset for biomedical research: 63 workflow skills, 51 public-data MCP tools, and a per-session subagent cap.
description.zh: 面向生物医学研究的自包含 agent 预设：63 个流程技能、51 个公开数据源 MCP 工具、3 个子智能体并发闸。

description.en: Biomedical research collaborator preset: 88 workflow skills covering variant calling/ACMG classification, epigenomics, methylation, RNA modification, immunogenomics, lipidomics, glycomics, proteomics, metabolomics, single-cell and spatial omics, plus structure prediction, literature evidence grading and manuscript delivery. Ships its own MCP server (51 public-data tools over PubMed/Ensembl/PDB/AlphaFold/ClinVar/gnomAD/GTEx/GEO/PRIDE/cBioPortal/CIViC/ENCODE/JASPAR/Rfam/ChEMBL/PubChem/Open Targets/openFDA/OpenAlex/arXiv).
description.zh: 生物医学研究合作者预设：88 个流程技能，覆盖变异检测与 ACMG 分级、表观遗传、甲基化、RNA 修饰、免疫组学、脂质组、糖组、蛋白组、代谢组、单细胞与空间组学，以及结构预测、文献证据分级与稿件交付。自带 MCP 服务（51 个公开数据源工具，覆盖 PubMed/Ensembl/PDB/AlphaFold/ClinVar/gnomAD/GTEx/GEO/PRIDE/cBioPortal/CIViC/ENCODE/JASPAR/Rfam/ChEMBL/PubChem/Open Targets/openFDA/OpenAlex/arXiv）。
